description: This file provides a polyfill implementation for the BitOperations class, including methods for bit manipulation tasks such as counting trailing zeros and computing logarithms. It defines specialized methods for uint and ulong types with fallback implementations using de Bruijn sequences, aimed at supporting environments where the native BitOperations class is unavailable or incompatible.

classes.name: BitOperations
classes.description: Provides static methods for advanced bit manipulation, such as counting trailing zeros, computing logarithms base 2, and rounding up to power of two, with platform-specific fallback implementations.

methods.name: Log2
methods.description: Returns the integer (floor) log base 2 of a 32-bit unsigned integer. Uses fallback if hardware intrinsics are not available.

methods.name: Log2
methods.description: Returns the integer (floor) log base 2 of a 64-bit unsigned integer by combining the 32-bit implementation.

methods.name: TrailingZeroCount
methods.description: Counts the number of trailing zero bits in a 32-bit unsigned integer, using a de Bruijn sequence-based fallback.

methods.name: TrailingZeroCount
methods.description: Counts the number of trailing zero bits in a 64-bit unsigned integer, delegating to the 32-bit version.

methods.name: RoundUpToPowerOf2
methods.description: Rounds the given unsigned integer up to the nearest power of two, returning 0 if the input is 0 or if the result overflows.
